title: cephalocarpus angustus
intro: Cephalocarpus angustus, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Cephalocarpus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Cephalotaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in the management of conditions such as arthritis and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cephalocarpus angustus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for infections and inflammatory diseases. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
